project_summary: Proposed fictional six-month pilot for twelve artists to practise pricing and test one simulated service offer each.
background_need: The fictional artists report limited pricing and customer-development skills; a starting-skills assessment is still needed.
beneficiaries: The participating fictional artists; wider local benefit is a hypothesis to examine
general_objective: Improve participants' ability to explain and test a service offer without promising increased income.

objectives.description: By the pilot end, participants demonstrate the cost and value reasoning of one proposed service offer.

work_packages.description: Proposed guided practice and simulated offer testing

activities.description: Proposed three guided sessions: assess starting skills, build an offer and practise a simulated customer discussion.

outputs: A proposed service offer and cost worksheet from each participating fictional artist

expected_results.description: Participants can explain the cost and customer value assumptions of their simulated offer.

proposed_indicators.description: Proportion of assessed participants who explain all agreed cost and value components.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Facilitator observes a simulated discussion at the final session using an agreed checklist; successful unique participants divided by all assessed participants. Starting level and a provisional target must be agreed first.

longer_term_impact: Improved enterprise confidence is a hypothesis; income or employment effects are not established by this pilot.

partner_roles.role: Proposed facilitator; capacity and commitment require confirmation.

timeline.period: Proposed months 1–6, with starting assessment before practice and final demonstration at the end.

risks.description: Participants may have uneven starting skills or limited attendance.
risks.mitigation: Confirm availability and adapt the practice tasks after the initial skills check.

assumptions: The six-month shared workshop access stated in the fictional idea remains available; facilitation is not yet confirmed.
sustainability: Proposed reusable worksheets and peer practice can continue if participants and the association confirm time and ownership.
open_questions: What starting-skill checklist and provisional target should participants agree?
